subject: [PATCH v2 1/2] zsmalloc: free a zspage's pages in one batch

reviews.author: Nhat Pham
reviews.summary: Raised a question about whether the old logic for incompressible cases should be kept, but did not object to the patch.

2026-11-24.patch_summary: Patch proposes to free a zspage's pages in one batch, potentially improving performance for multi-page zspages.

reviews.author: Sergey Senozhatsky
reviews.summary: Confirmed that batching comes as a win for multi-page zspages, but did not address Nhat's question about the incompressible case.
reviews.raw_body:
On (26/11/24 16:16), Nhat Pham wrote:
[..]
> [...]
> 
> > ---
> > +       zpdesc = get_first_zpdesc(zspage);
> > +       if (get_next_zpdesc(zpdesc)) {
> > +               free_page_chain(zpdesc);
> > +       } else {
> > +               /* Single-page zspage, e.g. a huge object: nothing to batch */
> 
> I wonder if it's worth keeping the old logic for incompressible case.

It does appear to be worth it, it's visible in profiles.  Batching comes
as a win for multi-page zspages.

2026-11-25.patch_summary: Patch proposes to free a zspage's pages in one batch, potentially improving performance for multi-page zspages.
